episodes.name: Pilot
episodes.overviewEn: A laboratory accident endows a police scientist with the ability to move at superhuman speed which he uses to battle a menacing gang as a superhero.
episodes.overviewAr: حادث في المختبر يمنح باري ألن، خبير الأدلة الجنائية في الشرطة، سرعة خارقة يستخدمها لمواجهة عصابة درّاجات نارية ترهب المدينة.

episodes.name: Out of Control
episodes.overviewEn: Homeless people are dying and their bodies are disappearing. Tina rekindles a relationship with a former colleague who is an expert in genetic engineering.
episodes.overviewAr: مشرّدون يموتون وجثثهم تختفي. وتينا تستعيد علاقتها بزميل سابق له يد في الأمر.

episodes.name: Watching the Detectives
episodes.overviewEn: The corrupt District Attorney Thomas Castillo hires a private eye named Megan Lockhart to find out the Flash's identity. He then blackmails Barry to work for him, or he'll expose his secret.
episodes.overviewAr: المدّعي العام الفاسد يستأجر محققة خاصة اسمها ميغان لوكهارت لتكشف هوية فلاش.

episodes.name: Honor Among Thieves
episodes.overviewEn: While arranging security at the Central City Museum, Barry is reunited with an old girlfriend and a former mentor.
episodes.overviewAr: وهو يرتّب حراسة متحف المدينة، يلتقي باري حبيبة قديمة ومعلّماً سابقاً، وأحدهما يخطط لسرقة.

episodes.name: Double Vision
episodes.overviewEn: Someone spreads graffiti, and messages asking to meet "Flash" at a church. Barry goes to the church. Shortly after that, he begins to experience black outs and memory losses.
episodes.overviewAr: رسائل على الجدران تطلب لقاء «فلاش» في كنيسة. يذهب باري، وبعدها يبدأ يتصرف كمن يتحكم فيه غيره.

episodes.name: Sins of the Father
episodes.overviewEn: A bank robber escapes from prison. He goes back to Central City to get his money and revenge on the cop who busted him, Henry Allen, Barry's father.
episodes.overviewAr: لص بنوك يهرب من السجن ويعود إلى المدينة لاسترداد ماله والانتقام من الشرطي الذي قبض عليه: والد باري.

episodes.name: Child's Play
episodes.overviewEn: An orphan boy has information that incriminates a 1960s cult figure who is trying to make a comeback.
episodes.overviewAr: صبي يتيم يملك ما يدين زعيم طائفة من الستينيات يحاول العودة إلى الواجهة.

episodes.name: Shroud of Death
episodes.overviewEn: Pieces of a broken medallion are the only clue to an unknown assassin who is on a deadly rampage in central city.
episodes.overviewAr: قطع من ميدالية مكسورة هي الخيط الوحيد إلى قاتل مجهول يعيث في المدينة.

episodes.name: Ghost in the Machine
episodes.overviewEn: Barry befriends an African American who was once a super hero that defeated a terrorist called the Ghost, who blackmailed the city through television sets. When the presumed dead criminal is defrosted, the Night Shade is back in business.
episodes.overviewAr: باري يصادق رجلاً كان في الخمسينيات بطلاً مقنّعاً هزم إرهابياً يسمّى «الشبح»، والإرهابي يعود من سباته.

episodes.name: Sight Unseen
episodes.overviewEn: An invisible man gets into Star Labs, and releases a neurotoxin with Tina inside the lab. Then he starts killing scientists who worked on the project. Flash must find the invisible man and save his friend.
episodes.overviewAr: رجل غير مرئي يتسلل إلى مختبرات ستار ويُطلق سمّاً عصبياً وتينا محبوسة في الداخل.

episodes.name: Beat the Clock
episodes.overviewEn: A jazz musician friend of Julio's is about to be executed. An hour before the execution, a friend calls and says he has evidence that could exonerate their friend. Before Barry can contact him, he disappears. They have less than an hour to save a condemned man.
episodes.overviewAr: عازف جاز صديق لخوليو يوشك أن يُعدَم، وقبل ساعة من التنفيذ يظهر دليل على براءته.

episodes.name: The Trickster
episodes.overviewEn: Barry must protect his old girlfriend, Megan Lockhart, from an obsessed, maniacal criminal disguised as The Trickster.
episodes.overviewAr: على باري حماية ميغان لوكهارت من مجرم مهووس يتنكر في هيئة تريكستر (The Trickster).

episodes.name: Tina, Is That You?
episodes.overviewEn: Barry is having trouble sleeping. Tina tries to use bio-feedback to help him, but it back fires on Tina. She joins a gang, and she's able to hold Flash at bay with her knowledge of his strengths and weaknesses. Barry has got to find a way to save his friend.
episodes.overviewAr: تينا تحاول معالجة أرق باري بجهاز، فيرتدّ عليها وتتحول إلى شخصية أخرى تنضم إلى عصابة.

episodes.name: Be My Baby
episodes.overviewEn: Barry tries to help a young woman. She found out about her husband's criminal life, and is trying to escape from him. She takes their daughter with her, but he wants them back.
episodes.overviewAr: باري يحاول مساعدة شابة اكتشفت حياة زوجها الإجرامية وتحاول الهرب منه مع رضيعها.

episodes.name: Fast Forward
episodes.overviewEn: Jay's killer, Nicholus Pike, is released from jail and blames the Flash for Jay's death.  He sets the Flash up by using a heat seeking bomb on him, but something goes awry.  Instead of killing the Flash, it sends him into the future where Pike is in charge and outlaws anyone from mentioning the Flash.
episodes.overviewAr: قاتل أخي باري يخرج من السجن وينصب لفلاش فخاً بصاروخ يقذفه عشر سنوات إلى المستقبل.

episodes.name: Deadly Nightshade
episodes.overviewEn: There's a new vigilante in town, the Deadly Nightshade, who fights crime by killing criminals. The Flash and the original Nightshade team up to take him down.
episodes.overviewAr: مقتصّ جديد يحارب الجريمة بقتل المجرمين منتحلاً اسم بطل قديم، وفلاش والبطل الأصلي يتصديان له.

episodes.name: Captain Cold
episodes.overviewEn: Captain Cold, who freezes his victims to death, is contracted to kill the Flash.
episodes.overviewAr: كابتن كولد، قاتل مأجور يجمّد ضحاياه حتى الموت، يُستأجر لقتل فلاش.

episodes.name: Twin Streaks
episodes.overviewEn: A scientist and his business partner are trying to develop a being with super speed, their attempts fail. They manage to clone the Flash. Their creation learns quickly, but is emotional moral equivalent of a child. Barry must stop his twin.
episodes.overviewAr: عالِم وشريكه يحاولان صنع كائن بسرعة خارقة، وينجحان أخيراً باستنساخ فلاش نفسه.

episodes.name: Done with Mirrors
episodes.overviewEn: A battery is stolen by a criminal calling himself the Mirror Master. He soon steals a crystal from Star Labs. Tina will get fired if they can't recover the crystal. Tina's mother comes for a visit, and an old friend of Barry's also stirs up trouble.
episodes.overviewAr: مجرم يسمّي نفسه ميرور ماستر يسرق بلّورة من مختبرات ستار، وسلاحه الخدع البصرية.

episodes.name: Good Night, Central City
episodes.overviewEn: A small time crook gets a hold of a device that puts people to sleep. He goes on a spree while the people are unconscious. He has a plan to knock out the entire city, it's up to the Flash to stop him.
episodes.overviewAr: مجرم صغير يحصل على جهاز يُنيم الناس، وينطلق في موجة سرقات والمدينة نائمة.

episodes.name: Alpha
episodes.overviewEn: An android built by the government to use an assassin refuses to obey her orders. She escapes, and is befriended by Tina and Barry.
episodes.overviewAr: آلية صنعتها الحكومة لتكون قاتلة ترفض تنفيذ الأوامر وتهرب، فتصادقها تينا.

episodes.name: The Trial of the Trickster
episodes.overviewEn: With the help of an insane admirer who wants to be his sidekick, the Trickster escapes from police custody and places the Flash under his mind control.
episodes.overviewAr: بمساعدة معجبة مجنونة تريد أن تكون مساعدته، يهرب تريكستر من الشرطة ويضع المدينة كلها في قفص الاتهام. الحلقة الأخيرة.
